clips.title: The story
paras: Rexxar says that slipping past the Black Flight's defenses calls for an illusion. He knows a master illusionist, Myranda the Hag, who lives in the Western Plaguelands, and sends you to her with a message.

Rexxar asks what you know of illusions, since an illusion is how you will get around the Black Flight's defenses. He names someone who may assist you in such deception: Myranda the Hag, a master illusionist driven out by the Lordaeron alliance, living in the Western Plaguelands. Rexxar says she has lent his kind a hand before, whenever she found a cause worthy. You carry his message to her.
Myranda remarks that a member of the Horde is a rare sight in these parts of Lordaeron, and she asks what you have brought her.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What do you know of illusions, friend? For you see, it is an illusion that you must create in order to circumvent the Black Flight's defenses.
I know of one that may be willing to assist you in your quest of deception. She has assisted our kind in the past when she has deemed the cause worthy.
In the Western Plaguelands you will find Myranda the Hag, master illusionist - an exile of the Lordaeron alliance. Travel there and take with you this message.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is not often I see one of the Horde in these parts of Lordaeron. What is it that you have for Myranda?

clips.title: Completion
paras: How is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!
Oh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, traveler. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.
